workgroup.description: The NetBIOS workgroup or domain name.

server_string.description: The description shown in network browsers (e.g., Windows Network).

security_mode.description: Security model: 'user' for local accounts or 'ads' for Active Directory domain members.

server_role.description: Server mode/role. 'standalone server' = local accounts; 'member server' = joins an existing domain; the DC roles make this box the domain controller.

map_to_guest.description: Controls when to map unknown users to guest account (e.g., 'Bad User', 'Never', 'Bad Password').

log_file.description: Path pattern for log files; '%m' is replaced by client machine name.

max_log_size.description: Maximum log file size in KB before rotation.

socket_options.description: TCP/IP socket options for performance tuning.

tcp_nodelay.description: Enable/disable TCP_NODELAY (disables Nagle's algorithm for lower latency).

read_raw.description: Enable raw read operations for better performance (recommended for local networks).

write_raw.description: Enable raw write operations for better performance.

load_printers.description: Whether to automatically load printer shares (disable if using only file shares).

printcap_name.description: Path to printcap file or device (e.g., '/dev/null' when not using CUPS).

idmap_range.description: ID range for mapping Windows users/groups to Unix UIDs/GIDs (for winbind).

winbind_enum_users.description: Allow enumeration of domain users (security risk — disable in production unless needed).

time_server.description: Act as an NTP time server for Windows clients (required for domain joined hosts).

unix_extensions.description: Enable Unix extensions (required for POSIX features like symlinks, ACLs). Disable for Windows-only compatibility.

hide_unreadable.description: Hide files/directories the user cannot read (per share or global setting).

create_mask.description: Octal permission mask for newly created files.

directory_mask.description: Octal permission mask for newly created directories.

printers.description: List of printer shares to configure.

browseable.description: Whether the share appears in network browsing.

read_only.description: Prevent users from submitting print jobs (should be false for printers).

printer_driver_location.description: Network path to printer driver files (e.g., '/srv/drivers').
